Sana (PM): Quick follow-up from the pm: we need to assign owners for the recurring DB connection leak findings and agree on timelines. Short round?
Jules (Eng): I can own the leak root cause PR + tests. Plan: small patch, add connection pooling guardrails, ETA 10 days.
Priya (SRE): I'll handle the alert tuning and add a long-running conn leak monitor. ETA: 3 days for alerts + dashboard.
Sana (PM): I'll create tickets and add RACI. Splitting: INF-2077-01 (rca + fix), INF-2077-02 (alerts + monitor), INF-2077-03 (soak test + rollout checklist).
ops-bot: Created INF-2077-01, INF-2077-02, INF-2077-03: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2077-01
Jules (Eng): Acceptance criteria for INF-2077-01: 1) no leak under 72h soak in staging, 2) connection count baseline within 10%, 3) rollback steps documented. Pushing draft branch: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1291
Priya (SRE): Alert rule proposal for INF-2077-02:
```n- alert: RisingOpenConnections
  expr: increase(db_open_connections[5m]) > 50
  for: 10m
```nI'll attach dashboard snapshots and validation steps.
Sana (PM): RACI: R=Jules, A=Sana, C=Priya, I=platform-eng. OK?
Jules (Eng): OK.
Priya (SRE): +1.
Sana (PM): Milestones: INF-2077-01 due 206500 + 86400 (10 days) -> setting due 2065880321, INF-2077-02 due 2065250000 (3 days), INF-2077-03 due 2065600000 (7 days). I'll add short "how to validate" bullets in each ticket.
Jules (Eng): Note: fix touches DB pool config — might need a short maintenance window. I'll call it out in the ticket.
Priya (SRE): I'll coordinate maintenance windows and tag ops.
Sana (PM): Please add 2-3 validation steps per ticket so QA can sign off. We'll reconvene in the weekly postmortem sync.
Jules (Eng): Will add tests and validation links.
Priya (SRE): Adding dashboard snapshots to INF-2077-02 now.
Sana (PM): Thanks all. If anything slips, update the ticket and ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
